```{r setup, include=FALSE}
require(interactions)
library(sjPlot)

mES_combinedAltValenceOnly <- lmer(ES_combined ~ valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))
performance(mES_combinedAltValenceOnly)
performance(mES_combinedAltValenceMain)


mPT_combinedAltValenceOnly <- lmer(PT_combined ~ valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))
performance(mPT_combinedAltValenceOnly)

mComp_combinedAltValenceOnly <- lmer(comp_combined ~ valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))
performance(mComp_combinedAltValenceOnly)


mPDAltValenceOnly <- lmer(PD ~ valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))
performance(mPDAltValenceOnly)


mEfficacyAltValenceOnly <- lmer(Emp_Efficacy ~ valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))
performance(mEfficacyAltValenceMain)

mExtentAltValenceOnly <- lmer(CombinedAvg_score ~ valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))
performance(mExtentAltValenceOnly)


mEmpAltValenceOnly <- glmer(E ~ valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), family = binomial, data = df, control=glmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))
performance(mEmpAltValenceOnly)

mDistressAltValenceOnly <- lmer(PD ~ valence_factorNeg + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))



### VALENCE ONLY MODELS HAD HIGHER BIC THEN VALENCE MAIN MODELS WITH EXCEPTION OF WHETHER PTCPTS EMPATHIZED OR NOT.

# Emo only

mEfficacyAltEmoOnly <- lmer(Emp_Efficacy ~ what_emo_namedPainRef + (1|User_Id/Survey_Day), data = df, control=lmerControl(optimizer= "bobyqa",optCtrl=list(maxfun=100000)))

performance(mEfficacyAltEmoMain)
```
